IMPLEMENTATION OF ELECTRONIC TRAVEL AUTHORIZATION SYSTEM (ETAS) IN SOMALIA
1 — Introduction
1.1 In line with the directives of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Immigration and Citizenship Agency (ICA) of the Federal Government of Somalia, an Electronic Travel Authorization System (eTAS) has been established and implemented. The platform, accessible at https://evisa.gov.so is designed to ensure that all travelers obtain an Electronic Travel Authorization (eTA) in advance of their travel date.
1.2 With effect from 1 September 2025, all travelers holding foreign passports must possess a valid eTA to be granted entry into the Federal Republic of Somalia.
2 — Exemptions from Electronic Travel Authorization (eTA) Requirement
2.1 Holders of diplomatic, service, or ordinary passports from Rwanda and Malaysia are granted visa-free entry into Somalia.
2.2 Holders of diplomatic, service, or ordinary passports from Ethiopia, Burundi, Djibouti, Mauritania, Tanzania, Uganda, Algeria, Libya, Tunisia, Egypt, and Comoros are eligible for visas on arrival.
2.3 Travelers holding multiple-entry visas, residence permits, or United Nations Laissez-Passer (UNLP) passports are also exempt from the eTA requirement.
3 — Instruction for compliance:
3.1 All travelers are advised that failure to present a valid eTA, where required, may result in denial of boarding or entry into Somalia.
4 — Contact information
4.1 for further inquiries, please contact the immigration and citizenship agency of federal government of Somalia at the following addresses: Email: [email protected]

GENERAL INFORMATION
The Consular Section of the Embassy of Cameroon in Cairo, Arab Republic of Egypt, outlines in detail the procedure for applying for Entry, stay, and transit Visas to Cameroon as well as other consular services availed to the public.
OPENING HOURS :
The Embassy is open to the public from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM, from Sunday to Thursday. It is closed to the public on all national holidays in Cameroon and in Egypt. For specific requests to the Consular Section, see the “News” pages.
ENTRY REQUIREMENTS
All person wishing to enter Cameroon must be in possession of a valid passport (minimum 6 months before the expire date) or a Travel Document clearly establishing his identification. Travel Documents include Laissez-Passer or other Special Passports issued by International Agencies recognized by the Government of Cameroon.
EXEMPTION TO THE REQUIREMENT OF AN ENTRY VISA
Nationals of Nigeria, the Republic of Congo, the Central African Republic and Chad are exempt from the visa requirement to enter Cameroon.
To these countries are added the holders of diplomatic, special or service passports, issued by countries with which Cameroon has signed a visa exemption agreement.
EXEMPTION FROM VISA FEES
Holders of Diplomatic, Service and Special Passports on official duty are exempted from visa fees.
IMPORTANT IMMIGRATION NOTICE
Travelers can be refused entry into Cameroon if they fall within the category of prohibited immigrants and if they do not satisfy immigration requirements at the point of entry. The Government of Cameroon will not be financially liable for their repatriation.
Visa Fees
Below are fees for entry visas. These fees are exclusively paid online, upon applying for visa via the website https://evisacam.cm. These fees may be revised from time to time without prior notice:
00 - 06 months, multiple or single entries and exits, ordinary visa: 100 000 CFA Francs.
00 - 06 months, single or multiple entries and exits, express visa: 150 000 CFA Francs.
Transit visa of more than four (04) days: 100 000 CFA Francs.
Single or multiple entries and exits visa valid for more than six (06) months: 200 000 CFA Francs.
Diplomatic and Courtesy Visa: free of charge.
Transit visa of less than five (05) days: free of charge.
GUIDELINES FOR VISA APPLICANTS
All visa applications must be submitted online at the following link https://evisacam.cm
All VISA APPLICATIONS take 3 working days to process.
Express visa applications are processed within maximum 02 working days.
Visa fees are payable exclusively online, in CFA Francs, during the pre-enrolment process on the following link: https://evisacam.cm. VISA FEES ARE NON-REFUNDABLE. Payment is possible by MasterCard, Debit Card, MTN Mobile Money, Orange Mobile Money.
Multiple-Entry Visas endorsed for six months means that the applicant is granted unlimited entries into Cameroon within six months from the date visa is issued.
Visa applicants from other countries of accreditation (Lebanon, Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan, Sudan, and Syria) are eligible to Authorization of Visa on arrival, upon approval of their request by the Embassy.
Visa applicants from cities in Egypt distant from Cairo (Aswan, Luxor, Port-Said) may also be eligible for Authorization of visa on arrival, subject to prior approval by the Embassy in Cairo.
APPLICANTS FOR AN ENTRY VISA TO CAMEROON MUST BE IN POSSESSION OF THE FOLLOWING:
For a transit Visa (5 days)
A valid passport or travel document with an expiry date of at least Six (6) months.
An airline ticket valid to the final destination or any other proof of onward travel.
visa or entry authorization to the country of final destination if applicable.
Copies of requested International Certificate of Vaccination.
N.B.: Other documents may be requested by consular officials.
Temporary Stay Visa (1-6 months, single or multiple entries)
A valid passport or travel document with an expiry date of at least Six (6) months.
A return airline or transport ticket, or a customs clearance book if applicable.
Required International Certificates of Vaccination.
Proof of the purpose of the visit as well as sufficient conditions and means of subsistence for the duration of the stay.
A certificate of accommodation issued by the person who undertakes to accommodate the visitor, bearing the visa of the territorially competent Mayor in Cameroon, or an invitation to an event organized on national territory, or a non-refundable hotel booking for the planned duration of the stay.
A mission order if applicable.
N.B.: Other documents may be requested by consular officials.
Long Stay Visa (6-12 months stay, single or multiple entries)
A valid passport or travel document with an expiry date of at least Six (6) months.
A airline or any transport ticket valid to Cameroon.
A proof of required International Certificate of Vaccination (against Yellow Fever. However, other vaccines and treatment for malaria are recommended).
The repatriation guarantee (a non-refundable plane ticket valid for at least one year, or proof of equivalent funds to be deposited in the public treasury upon arrival in Cameroon).
A certificate of registration or re-registration issued by the head of the School/College/University or Institute for students.
An internship placement certificate signed by a competent authority, for interns.
A work contract signed by the Minister in charge of Employment for foreigners wishing to work in Cameroon.
An authorization to exercise a liberal profession or to promote an agricultural, pastoral, industrial, commercial, artistic or other activity issued by the competent authority, when such authorization is required.
A proof of marital bond for the spouse, or parental bond for dependent minor children.
N.B.: Other documents may be requested by consular officials.
TRAVEL CERTIFICATES/LAISSEZ-PASSER
Cameroonian Travel Certificates (commonly known as Laissez-Passer) are issued only to Cameroonian citizens who are not in possession of National Passports and require traveling to Cameroon on the request of immigration officers (deportation) and exceptionally to others. This document is valid for a maximum of one month.
Applicants will be required to produce evidence of Cameroonian nationality such as photocopy of former passport, birth certificate, or national identity card. They are required to present themselves personally at the Mission for an interview prior to the issuance of the document unless the request has been introduced by the immigration services.
REGISTRATION OF CAMEROONIAN CITIZENS
Cameroonians residing abroad are required, at the earliest opportunity, to register their names and addresses at the nearest Diplomatic Mission or Consulate of Cameroon (for residents in Egypt, Jordan, Lebanon, the Sudan and Syria : www.cameroonconsular.com) They may be issued a consular card. Failure to abide with this consular obligation may, in case of emergency, result in difficulty or delay in availing the necessary assistance and protection they are entitled to. Changes of address or departure from the country should also be notified to the Consular Service. Visitors are not entitled to consular cards.
REPLACEMENT OF LOST PASSPORTS
The application for the replacement of a lost passport must be submitted online on the website https://www.passcam.cm/. The applicant must follow all the instructions mentioned therein and present himself at the Embassy on the day of his appointment, with the required documents, for his enrollment.
The processing deadline for the application remains the same as that of the first application or the renewal of the passport.
RENEWAL/APPLICATION FOR PASSPORT
Applications for renewal or issuance of a new passport must be submitted via the following link: (https://www.passcam.cm). This website provides extensive information on required documents. It is recommended to legalize all copies of the required documents, as well as to obtain parental authorization, if necessary, before initiating the online procedure.
The Embassy is not responsible for missed biometric data collection appointments.

Requirements, payment methods, supporting documents
Every traveller needs a visa to enter Madagascar, regardless of
Tourism visa applicant residing in the U.S.A., regardless of the nationality, may apply for a visa either at the Embassy or upon arrival at any international airport / port in Madagascar.
Processing time: 7 business days. You are advised to apply at least fifteen (15) days before your trip.
Visa fee payment methods
Cash, certified check or money order made payable to "The Embassy of Madagascar".
No personnal check.
Supporting documents
With the exception of the passport, vaccination certificate and airline ticket, all other supporting documents will not be returned to the applicant.
The visa will be issued only when the application is completed and signed, and all supporting documents are received.
Mail application: please provide a prepaid self-addressed envelope (USPS priority mail, UPS, FedEx or DHL). It will be used to send the passport back to the applicant.

Consular service of Turkmenistan
Law “On Consular Offices of Turkmenistan Abroad”
Procedure for entry to and exit from Turkmenistan
Consular activity
Consular offices of Turkmenistan abroad and their functions
I. On Consular Offices of Turkmenistan Abroad
Legal bases of activity, procedure for establishing and functioning of consular offices of Turkmenistan, the appointment of their officers and employees, as well as the functions of consuls on safeguarding rights and interests of Turkmenistan, its nationals and bodies corporate abroad are defined in accordance with the Law of Turkmenistan “On Consular Offices of Turkmenistan Abroad.”Consular offices contribute to the development of friendly relations of Turkmenistan with other states, the expansion of economic, commercial, scientific, technical, cultural relations and tourism.Turkmenistan opens its consular offices in the countries with which consular relations are established.In the absence of agreements concerning the establishment of consular relations, the establishment of diplomatic relations is considered as the establishment of consular relations as well. Consular offices of Turkmenistan are opened and terminated by the decree of the President of Turkmenistan. A preliminary agreement on the opening of consular offices is based on bilateral interstate treaties, agreements and protocols.Consular offices in its activities are regulated by the Constitution of Turkmenistan, the current Law, other acts of the legislation of Turkmenistan, the universally-recognized norms of international law and international treaties towhich Turkmenistan is a party. Consular offices are includedinto the system of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistan and are accountable to it for their activities.In the receivingstate consular offices operate under the general guidance of the head of the diplomatic mission of Turkmenistan in this state.
The consular offices of Turkmenistan are divided into the following groups:
Consulate generals;
Consulates;
Vice-consulates;
Consular agencies.
The consular offices of diplomatic missions of Turkmenistan are managed by the head of consular departments who are called consuls general or consuls.
In the states where there are no diplomatic representations of Turkmenistan, with the consent of the receiving state,diplomatic functions can be also assigned to consular offices.
Consular offices of Turkmenistan,with the consent of the receiving state, can perform consular functions on behalf of the third state.
The consular office of a foreign state can perform consular functions on behalf of Turkmenistan in the third state.
The consular office of Turkmenistan, with the consent of the receiving state, and in the absence of objections of the third state can perform consular functions in this third state.
Procedure for performance of consular functions includes:
Consular functions concerning bodies corporate and nationals of Turkmenistan.
Consul is obliged to take measures so that national sand bodies corporate of Turkmenistan can be nefit from all rights provided by the legislation of the receiving state and international treaties to which Turkmenistan and the receiving state are parties, as well as international customs.
Moreover, consulimplementsnotarialacts, consular legalization, consular fees. Consular functions include actions concerning the warships of Turkmenistan,the vessels of Turkmenistan,the civil aircrafts of Turkmenistan,sanitary, photo-medical and veterinary protection.
II. Procedure for entry to and exist from Turkmenistan
Foreign citizens, stateless persons can enter to and stay in the territory of Turkmenistan on the basis of entry visas to Turkmenistan unless otherwise is provided by international agreements of Turkmenistan.The issuance of entry visasto Turkmenistan and the extension of the term of their validityfor foreign citizens, stateless persons is carried out in the following manner:in the territory of Turkmenistan - through the State Migration Service of Turkmenistan;outside Turkmenistan - through diplomatic representations and consular offices of Turkmenistan in foreign states.
Categories and types of visas and the procedure for their registration, issue and extension of the term of their validity are regulated by the Law of Turkmenistan “On Migration” and other regulations of Turkmenistan.
Bases for the issuance of visas for entry to Turkmenistan and exit from Turkmenistan and the extension of their term of validity of visas for foreign citizens, stateless persons are:
for the staff of diplomatic missions, consular establishments and other representations of foreign states equated to them and the international organizations in Turkmenistan, the foreign journalists accredited in Turkmenistan, and also for members of their families – the accreditation card which is given out by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistan, and written requests of these representations, establishments and organizations;
for foreign citizens, stateless persons arriving to Turkmenistan through the accepting organizations of Turkmenistan and permanent foreign missions, - written requests of these organizations and representations;
for foreign citizens, stateless persons arriving to Turkmenistan with official and business purposes, - the written application of accepting organizations with the appendix of necessary documents certifying official or business trips;
for foreign citizens, stateless persons arriving to Turkmenistan for the purpose of implementation of labor activities, - the permission of the State Migration Service of Turkmenistan forthe implementation of labor activities in Turkmenistan;
for foreign citizens, stateless persons arriving to Turkmenistan on private affairs, - the invitation of individuals in the established sample or the written application of the foreign citizen, stateless persons;
for foreign citizens, stateless persons who have transit through the territory of Turkmenistan, - a personal statement with the appendix of the travel document with the visa of the nextstate;for foreign citizens, stateless persons arriving to Turkmenistan for tourism, - a personal statement or the written application of the accepting tourist organization;
for foreign citizens, stateless persons arriving to Turkmenistan for education – written applications of educational institutions;
for foreign citizens, stateless persons arriving to Turkmenistan for medical examination and treatment, - a personal statement and documents issued by medical institutions and confirming the need for arrivals of these persons in Turkmenistan;
for the individuals who are a part of crews of vehicles of foreign states engaged in the transportation of passengers and cargos on international messages, - a personal statement or the written application of the accepting organization;
in case of arrival of a foreign citizen and stateless person in Turkmenistan without visaand stay in its territory, as well as in connection with cancellation or visa expiration - personal statement of these persons for the issuance of exit visa.
Forms of requests and the list of the documents enclosed to the request shall be approved by the State Migration Service of Turkmenistan.
Foreign citizens, stateless persons are obliged to leave Turkmenistan in the following cases:
After the expiration date of visa;
in case of the rejection of applications for visa extension;
the reduction of the term of stay in the territory of the state or visa cancellation;
and also after the expiration of the term of stay in Turkmenistan determined by other reasons.
Individuals, bodies corporateand accepting organizations that invite foreign citizens, stateless personsare obliged to explain their rights and duties provided by the legislation of Turkmenistan in due time, toprovide the observance of the legislation of Turkmenistan by them andto take measures for their timely registration and paperwork on stay in Turkmenistan, the implementation of work activities, the movement within the state, on removal from the record in connection with the termination of the established period of stay in the state and in connection with their departure from Turkmenistan.
III. Consular activity
The provision of consular relations of Turkmenistan with foreign states, the protection of the rights and legitimate interests of Turkmenistan, its citizens and legal entities abroad is coordinated by the Consular office – the structural division of central office of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistan.
Currently, two Consulates of Turkmenistan in the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan in Herat and Mazar-i-Sharif, the Consulate general of Turkmenistan in the Islamic Republic of Iran in Mashhad, the Consulate general of Turkmenistan in the Republic of Turkey in Istanbul function in accordance with the Law of Turkmenistan “On Consular Offices of Turkmenistan Abroad.” Consular offices include consular departments of diplomatic missions of Turkmenistan abroad. They protect the rights and interests of Turkmenistan, individuals and bodies corporate of Turkmenistan.
Consular officials, within their competence, act as notary and civil registrar andalso legalize documents and various statements made by the authorities of the consular district or proceedings from these authorities. Along with the protection of the rights and representation of legitimate interests of citizens of Turkmenistan abroad, they inform them on the existing laws and stay rules in the receiving state, make necessary recommendations, take appropriate measures to ensure security in emergency situations.
The legal status of citizens of Turkmenistan abroad is defined, first of all, by the legislation of the receiving state. The provisions of consular conventions and agreements on legal aid on civil, family and criminal cases are also of great significance.
IV. Consular offices of Turkmenistan abroad and their functions
1. Information on the procedure for the requirements of documents
Turkmen citizens may apply to the diplomatic missions and consular offices of Turkmenistan abroad to reclaim required documents. In cases where the required document of a citizen is in the territory of Turkmenistan, the following procedure of claim is applied.The person concerned addresses to the diplomatic mission or consular office in the state of his residence and fills two copies of the application form foreach claimed document and pays the appropriate visa fee.Filled request is sent by a diplomatic mission or consular office through the Consular Office (CO) at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistan in appropriate archival institutions in the territory of Turkmenistan. After searching, archival institutions return requested documents to the diplomatic mission or consular officethrough the CO of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistan. In cases where the search of document is not possible, archival institution shall inform the applicant through the CO of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistan.Originals of passports, work books, military cards are not subject to a claim, sending abroad. If necessary, references on length of service and military service can be sent abroad.
Depending on the category of the request for claim of documents, its implementation in Turkmenistan is carried out by the following bodies:
Central Archive of the Registrar of Turkmenistan;
Main Archive Office under the Cabinet of Ministers of Turkmenistan;
Ministry of Internal Affairs;
Red Crescent Society of Turkmenistan.
People living in Turkmenistan, Turkmen citizens can request the CO of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistan for the claim of documents from other states.The claim procedure depends on the completeness of the input data and the requirements of the legislation of the state ofthe origin of the document. It should be taken into account that the claim of documents from abroad requires a long time.
2. Information on the procedure of legalization of documents
Legalization is a proof for the document emanating from the authorities of the state or compiled with the assistance of the authorities and consistent with the law of that state. It lies in the authentication of signature of the person signing the document and the seal of the authorized state body.In accordance with international practice, there is no need for the legalization of passports and substituting documents.The documents and acts that are contrary to the laws of Turkmenistan or its content may harm the interests of Turkmenistan or contain information discrediting the honor and dignity of citizens, as well as the originals and copies of passports, work books, military cards, identity cards, the ownership of the property, documents that are directly related to commercial or customs operations (accounts, documents on the movement of goods across the border, the agreement for the supply of goods, customs declarations, etc.) are not subject to legalization. Legalization of documents for use abroad.
Legalization of documents for use abroad is carried out in the following manner:
The notary office in Turkmenistan notarizes a copy of the document;
The Ministry of Justice of Turkmenistan testifies the authenticity of the signature and seal of a notary;
The Consular Office of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistan confirms the authenticity of the seal of the Ministry of Justice of Turkmenistan and the signature of the official.
After the legalization of the CO of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistan, the documents are legalized at the diplomatic mission or consular post of the state where they are used. In addition, a foreign consul confirms on the basis of its existing samples of the authenticity of the signature and the seal of the authorized officer of the CO of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistan. Documents are legalized in notarized copies. The exception is education documents for use abroad, whichare legalized in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistan in the original.Consular fee will be charged and collected on the account of reimbursement of actual expenses for the completion of legalization in the CO of the Ministry of Foreign Ministry of Turkmenistan. The legalization of foreign documents for the execution in the territory of Turkmenistan Foreign documents intended for use in the territory of Turkmenistan are legalized by diplomatic missions or consular offices of Turkmenistan abroad after the legalization at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistan, or otherwise authorized body of the state of origin of the document. Documents of foreign countries brought to Turkmenistan without legalization in diplomatic missions or consular offices of Turkmenistan abroad are legalizedby diplomatic representations of a foreign country in the territory of Turkmenistan where they were made and then by the CO of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistan. Bilateral agreements on legal assistance and legal relations in civil, family and criminal cases, prisoners in Turkmenistan, as well as the Convention on Legal Assistance and Legal Relations in Civil, Family and Criminal Matters, signed on January 22, 1993 in Minsk by CIS member states, determine the order, in accordance of which the documents issued by the official authorities of a contracting party shall be regarded as official and use in the territory of the other contracting party by probative value of official documents without any additional license, i.e. without legalization.
3. The consular record and registration of citizens of Turkmenistan abroad.
General provisions
In accordance with Article 29 of the Law of Turkmenistan “On Consular Offices of Turkmenistan Abroad,” diplomatic missions and consular offices of Turkmenistan abroad implement the record and registration of citizens of Turkmenistan who are in the territory of their consular district. Turkmen citizens who are outside of Turkmenistan have the right to register (up to consulate) in the diplomatic mission or consular office of Turkmenistan.Registration of citizens of Turkmenistan is free. The CO of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistanstrongly recommends to use this opportunity. While not binding, this procedure allows to solve many problems without having to travel to Turkmenistan (provision of information about the upcoming elections and referenda, registration certificates, registration of acts of civil status, etc.), as well as facilitate return tothe homeland in the event of the war,riots or natural disasters in the receiving state. Consular registration at the diplomatic mission or consulate of Turkmenistan is currently carried out online. This can be done by filling out the consular registration page on the official website of the diplomatic mission or consulate of Turkmenistan located or accredited in the foreign state, where the citizen resides.

Please visit https://nepaliport.immigration.gov.np/ to apply for a visa. For instructions on the webpage please click here.
Instructions for visa processing
General
No Visa Fee is charged from Chinese Nationals for Tourist visa (other than Chinese Nationals are, however, required to pay visa fee)
Holders of Diplomatic and Official Passport of the People"s Republic of China do not require visa for visit and stay in Nepal for up to one month. Similarly, holders of Diplomatic and Official passport of Mongolia do not require visa for visit and stay in Nepal for up to three months.
Passports are not accepted through parcel.
Individual applicant should apply in person at the Embassy in Beijing or at the consulates in Lhasa, Hong Kong, Guangzhou or any diplomatic mission of Nepal abroad.
Chinese nationals are eligible to obtain on-arrival visa at authorized entry points including the Tribhuvan International Airport in Kathmandu. This provision also applies to Mongolia and DPRK nationals.
Tourist visa for Nepal can also be applied through travel agencies authorized by the China National Tourism Administration (CNTA) to operate overseas travel.
Passports should be valid for at least more than six months for processing of visa.
Please fill in the application form completely/correctly, don"t leave any column vacant (the provided data on the application will be verified by our staff).
Nationals of other countries visiting China (as visitors, tourists) are advised to apply for visa at the Embassy of Nepal in their country of residence or the Embassy of Nepal concurrently accredited to their country.

Tourist Visa

{Chinese nationals are exempted from visa fee for Tourist Visa}

Required Documents:

Duly filled in visa application form online.
Copies of Passport and identity Card.
One recent passport size photograph affixed to the form (size: 35*45 mm)
Birth Certificate (for children under the age of 10 years)
Provide real and valid round-trip air tickets and hotel orders.

[Note: Employment is strictly prohibited under this category of visa]

Online application for tourist visa (Link: Online Services (immigration.gov.np))

Chinese nationals as well as nationals of other countries those who wish to visit Nepal may apply online in order to avoid long queues and unnecessary hassles at the entry points of Nepal. Kindly submit a complete Online Visa Application form to the Immigration Authority of Nepal in your first attempt! To do that, here are few things you need to prepare:

Please keep your valid passport at hand.
Ready a recent digital photograph (size: 1.5” x 1.5”) in your removable device to upload your photograph for the application.
Gather beforehand: a) a detailed permanent residence address, and b) detailed address in Nepal.
You need to provide telephone numbers—landline and mobile.
You need to provide your email address too.
The submitted application will remain in the system for 15 days. After 15 days, the application will be deleted automatically from the system.
Once the application is successfully submitted, a receipt will be sent to your email immediately.
Print the receipt and keep it with you as you need to produce it before the Immigration Authority.
For your convenience, the deadline to contact the Immigration Authority will be mentioned in the receipt.
The receipt also mentions about the documents you need to produce before the Immigration Authority.
Please contact the Immigration Authority within 15 days after the submission of application.
For example, if you submit your extension application today, and your visa is expiring the next day, on the third day if you visit the Department of Immigration, you will have to pay late fee of that day. In order to prevent this sort of hassle, please submit your extension application on time and get your visa renewed before crossing the expiry date.
When you contact the Immigration Authority, please make sure you have the receipt and proper documents with you including the necessary fee.

Visa Fee

Tourist Visa Fee:

1. Chinese nationals are exempted from visa fee

2. For other nationals:

15-days multiple entry: RMB 225

30-days multiple entry: RMB 375

90-days multiple entry: RMB 950

3. Only RMB in cash will be accepted. Please bring the exact amount.

4. On-arrival applicants need to pay USD 30, USD 50 and USD 125 for the period of 15, 30 and 90 days respectively.

Gratis Visa (Visa for Free)

Gratis Visa is issued free of cost in case of following categories of Visa applicants:
Children below 10 years except US citizens
Up to 30 days for SAARC Citizen (except Afghanistan) visiting Nepal for the first time in a given visa Year. Afghan citizen are eligible for Gratis Visa on Arrival only upon the recommendation of Department of Immigration. If you are an Afghan citizen, you can request concerned institution inviting you to Nepal for necessary paperwork with Department of Immigration to get you Gratis Visa "On Arrival".
Non-Resident Nepalese (NRN) Card holder (issued by MoFA /Nepalese Diplomatic Missions abroad)
Chinese Nationals

Diplomatic /Official Visa

For Diplomatic and Official passport holders from China, visa is not required for the period not exceeding one month each time. Similarly, for Diplomatic and Official passport holders from Russia, Thailand, Brazil and Mongolia, visas are not required for the period not exceeding three months each time. However, to get a diplomatic or official visa, copy of the invitation and letter from the Ministry concerned or Embassies are required.

Note: Chinese Passport for Public Affairs requires a visa, either at the Embassy/Consulate or on-arrival.

Business/Student Visa

For business, student, resident, non-tourist, marriage and visa of other categories, please contact your sponsor in Nepal or the Department of Immigration, Kathmandu (For more details please visit Nepal immigration website www.nepalimmigration.gov.np)

FAQ (VISA)

What are the requirements for obtaining a Tourist visa?

All applicants should fill out up a Visa application form, which can be downloaded from the Embassy"s website (click here to download). Applicants should include the original passport and its copy and one passport size recent photograph.

Can I apply visa online?

Yes. You can apply visa online in order to avoid unnecessary queues at the entry points of Nepal. Please refer to online.nepalimmigration.gov.np. Once you submit your application you will receive a receipt in your email, which you can present to immigration officer at the entry points of Nepal, including Tribhuvan International Airport. Please note that your application will remain in the system for 15 days. After 15 days the application will be deleted automatically from the system.

Where do I apply to get my visa?

You can apply in person at the Embassy in Beijing, Consulates of Nepal in Lhasa, Hong Kong and Guangzhou, and Honorary Consulate of Nepal in Shanghai or apply through registered travel agencies by the CNTA.

I am In Mongolia. How can I get a visa?

Nationals of Mongolia can apply visit visa at the Honorary Consulate"s Office in Ulaanbaatar. They also can obtain visa on arrival at any entry points of Nepal.

How long does it take to obtain a visa from the Embassy?

The Embassy collects application forms in the morning from 10:00-12:00 hrs. and issues visas after 3 working days in the afternoon from 15:00-16:00hrs. For example, Visa applications made on Monday can be collected on Thursday afternoon.

How much do I need to pay for Nepal visa?

Chinese nationals are exempted from tourist visa fees. Likewise, children below 10 years and nationals of SAARC countries are also exempted from visa fees for the period of 30 days.

As a tourist, can I stay longer than 150 days continuously in two calendar years?

Yes. Visitors who have entered into Nepal towards the end of one calendar year may prolong his/her stay beyond 150 days by adding the maximum period of another 150 days allowable for the next calendar year. However, tourists who have left Nepal before the expiration of the visa issued to him/her for the current year shall not be allowed to use or carry forward the unused period of visa to another calendar year.

Can I work with a tourist visa?

No. A foreigner having a tourist visa shall not be allowed to work in Nepal, with or without receiving remuneration.

I am a Chinese national. Do I need to pay any fee for Tourist visa to Nepal?

No. Chinese Nationals are exempted from visa fee for Tourist visa. Except Chinese nationals the following applicants of other than Chinese are entitled to obtain a gratis visa from the Embassy:

Children under the age of 10 years.
A 30 day visa for the citizens of SAARC countries (such a visa is issued once in a calendar year).

Who are exempt from obtaining a visa to visit Nepal?

Diplomatic and Official passport holders of the People"s Republic of China, Russia, Thailand, Brazil and Mongolia and the UN Lassies Passer Holders do not need a visa to visit Nepal.

Can I obtain a visa on arrival in Nepal?

Yes. Except nationals of few countries all nationals are entitled to obtain visa on arrival. However, a prior visa is always recommended to avoid any unforeseen last minute hassle.

Which countries are on the list whose nationals are not eligible to obtain a visa on arrival?

Nigeria, Somalia, Liberia, Cameroon, Ethiopia, Ghana, Swaziland, Iraq, Palestine and Afghanistan and all Travel Document holder applicants needs visa in advance. They are advised to apply for a visa at the Embassy prior to their visit to Nepal.

How long is an entry valid for?

A visa issued by the Embassy is valid for six months from the date of issue. The validity of a visa date is computed, however, from the date of arrival in Nepal.

Do I need come in person at the Embassy to submit my application in person?

Submission of the application in person is always a preferred option.

It is mandatory for the applicant from Nigeria, Somalia, Cameroon, Ethiopia, Zimbabwe, Ghana, Swaziland, Iraq, Palestine and Afghanistan and holders of Travel Documents to come in person to apply for a visa.

Can I get a transit visa for Nepal?

Yes. Transit passengers willing to spend overnight in Nepal on their way to any third country with confirmed air tickets, and passengers of aircraft that had to make an emergency landing in Nepal are eligible to obtain a transit visa.

Are there overland entry and exit points between Nepal and India and Nepal and China borders?

Yes. The overland Immigration Offices are located at the following entry and exit points between Nepal and India and Nepal and the People"s Republic of China.

Tatopani (Sindhupalchok District)

Copy link thành công
Bộ Tài chính đã chính thức ban hành Thông tư số 28/2026/TT-BTC quy định mức thu, chế độ thu, nộp phí, lệ phí trong lĩnh vực xuất cảnh, nhập cảnh, quá cảnh và cư trú tại Việt Nam. Văn bản mới này không chỉ cập nhật chi tiết danh mục mức thu đối với hộ chiếu, thị thực mà còn bổ sung các quy định cụ thể về đối tượng miễn phí và cơ chế hoàn trả lệ phí cho người dân có hiệu lực từ ngày 01/04/2026.
​Nhằm giúp người dân và các tổ chức trên địa bàn tỉnh Tây Ninh nắm bắt kịp thời các quy định mới, Phòng Quản lý xuất nhập cảnh Công an tỉnh thông tin những điểm đáng chú ý liên quan đến thủ tục cấp hộ chiếu, giấy thông hành và các giấy tờ cư trú cho người nước ngoài như sau:
1. Mức lệ phí cấp hộ chiếu và giấy thông hành biên giới ​Đối với công dân Việt Nam, Thông tư 28 quy định rõ các mức lệ phí đối với hộ chiếu (bao gồm cả loại gắn chíp và không gắn chíp) và giấy thông hành:
Cấp mới hộ chiếu: 200.000 đồng/lần cấp.
​Cấp lại hộ chiếu (do bị hỏng hoặc mất): 400.000 đồng/lần cấp. ​
Giấy thông hành biên giới Việt Nam - Campuchia: 50.000 đồng/lần cấp.
​Lệ phí cấp thẻ ABTC cho doanh nhân: Cấp mới là 840.000 đồng và cấp lại là 700.000 đồng. ​
2. Phí cấp thị thực và giấy tờ cư trú cho người nước ngoài ​Đối với người nước ngoài đang tạm trú hoặc làm việc tại các khu công nghiệp, khu kinh tế trên địa bàn tỉnh, mức phí được áp dụng theo đơn vị USD (có thể thu bằng đồng Việt Nam theo tỷ giá quy đổi): ​
Thị thực có giá trị một lần: 25 USD/chiếc. ​
Thị thực nhiều lần: Tùy theo thời hạn, mức phí dao động từ 50 USD (không quá 90 ngày) đến 165 USD (thời hạn từ 5 năm đến 10 năm). ​
Cấp thẻ tạm trú: Từ 145 USD đến 165 USD tùy thời hạn. ​
Gia hạn tạm trú: 10 USD/lần. ​
Trẻ em dưới 14 tuổi khi cấp thị thực không phân biệt thời hạn được áp dụng mức phí đồng nhất là 25 USD. ​
3. Các trường hợp được miễn phí, lệ phí ​Thông tư 28 tiếp tục duy trì chính sách nhân đạo và đối ngoại thông qua việc miễn phí trong các trường hợp: ​
Khách mời của Đảng, Nhà nước, Chính phủ, Quốc hội. ​
Người nước ngoài vào Việt Nam thực hiện cứu trợ hoặc giúp đỡ nhân đạo cho các tổ chức, cá nhân Việt Nam. ​
Người Việt Nam ở nước ngoài có quyết định trục xuất của nước sở tại nhưng không có hộ chiếu, hoặc phải về nước theo các điều ước quốc tế về nhận trở lại công dân.
4. Quy định về hoàn trả và thực hiện nộp phí, trường hợp người dân đã nộp lệ phí nhưng không đủ điều kiện được cấp hộ chiếu, giấy thông hành hoặc các giấy phép liên quan, tổ chức thu sẽ hoàn trả lại số tiền này khi thông báo kết quả. Tuy nhiên, nếu người nộp tự ý từ chối nhận kết quả xử lý hồ sơ, số lệ phí đã nộp sẽ không được hoàn trả. ​Riêng đối với phí cấp thị thực và các giấy tờ cư trú cho người nước ngoài, nếu không đủ điều kiện cấp hoặc từ chối nhận kết quả, tổ chức thu phí sẽ không hoàn trả số tiền đã thu.
Việc ban hành Thông tư 28/2026/TT-BTC là bước đi quan trọng trong việc cụ thể hóa Luật Phí và lệ phí, đảm bảo sự đồng bộ với các luật sửa đổi liên quan đến xuất nhập cảnh vừa được Quốc hội thông qua. Thông tư này có hiệu lực thi hành kể từ ngày 01/4/2026, thay thế các Thông tư cũ gồm Thông tư số 25/2021/TT-BTC, Thông tư số 62/2023/TT-BTC và các văn bản sửa đổi trước đó.A
Mọi vướng mắc trong quá trình thực hiện, các tổ chức, cá nhân liên hệ trực tiếp tại bộ phận tiếp nhận và trả kết quả của Phòng Quản lý xuất nhập cảnh Công an tỉnh Tây Ninh theo địa chỉ Số 02, Quốc lộ 1, phường Long An (số điện thoại 02723.827.622) hoặc Số 123, Trường Chinh, phường Tân Ninh, tỉnh Tây Ninh (số điện thoại 0693.531.257) trong giờ hành chính để được hỗ trợ, hướng dẫn chi tiết kịp thời./.

Electronic visa (E-visa)
On the start of issuing Russian unified electronic visas to foreign citizens
In accordance with the decision of the President of the Russian Federation, from August 1, 2023, a practical launch of a system for issuing unified electronic visas to foreign citizens valid throughout the Russian Federation will be carried out. At the same time, the list of foreign states whose citizens are issued such a visa, which currently includes 52 countries, will be preserved and expanded. In the near future, Vietnam, Cambodia and Myanmar will be additionally included in this list, approved by Decree of the Government of the Russian Federation dated October 6, 2020 No. 2571-r.
An electronic visa is issued on the basis of a foreign citizen's application filled in electronically on the specialized website of the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs
https://electronic-visa.kdmid.ru/index_en.html or through a mobile application available for download on the specified website.
An application for a single electronic visa must be submitted no later than 4 calendar days before the expected date of entry into the Russian Federation. A digital photograph of the face and a scan of the page with the data of the machine-readable passport of a foreign citizen are attached to the application. No other documents are required to obtain a single e-visa.
In accordance with the current Russian legislation, a visa fee has to be paid.
A single electronic visa allows a foreign citizen to enter the Russian Federation once and stay in the Russian Federation on a guest or business visit, as a tourist, as well as to participate in scientific, cultural, socio-political, economic, sports events and make relevant connections and contacts.
The validity of a single electronic visa is 120 days from the date of its issuance with the permitted period of stay of a foreign citizen in the Russian Federation no more than 30 days from the date of entry into the territory of the Russian Federation.
Unified electronic visas are valid for single entry into the Russian Federation and exit from the Russian Federation by air, road and water transport, as well as without the use of vehicles only through checkpoints across the state border of the Russian Federation, the list of which was approved by the Decree of the Government of the Russian Federation dated October 23, 2020 No. 2741-r. Currently, this list consists of 92 checkpoints. Below in this section of the site there is the translation of this Decree into English as of July 26, 2023. It is recommended to request up-to-date information from the tour operator and the carrier company.
Transport companies can check that a foreign citizen has a valid unified electronic visa on a special website of the Russian Foreign Ministry https://evisacheck.kdmid.ru
Information on the verification procedure is available there in Russian and English.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
APPLYING FOR A VISA
What are the rules for issuing an electronic visa to enter Russia?
Please find out more about the specific features of the electronic visa.
When planning your visit to the Russian Federation using an e-visa, please remember the following: the time period for processing your application (4 calendar days) does not include the day of application submission. If after the verification of your application you are asked to correct the inaccurately submitted data, your application processing period will also be changed and will be counted from the day of resubmission of your application data for verification.
I cannot take a correct photo, the system does not accept the photo taken.
Carefully read the recommendations and requirements for the photo to be uploaded (see the electronic application form). If your e-visa application was returned to change the photo, please contact the Visa Application Center through which you paid the consular fee:
1) support@sinovisa.org, help@sinovisa.org.
2) https://support.gkd-global.com.
When filling in the application form, the system shows an error in the field "passport number" (does not meet the requirements). What should I do?
Please inform us about it at evisa_info@kdmid.ru with a photo of your passport attached.
I am transiting through Russia, but I cannot select "transit" as a travel purpose in the application form. What should I indicate in the application form?
The electronic visa entitles you to enter the Russian Federation and stay in the Russian Federation for a guest or business visit, as a tourist, as well as to participate in scientific, cultural, socio-political, economic, sporting events and to establish relevant communications and contacts. If the purpose of your trip to the Russian Federation does not correspond to any of the above, you should apply to a diplomatic mission or consular office of the Russian Federation for a paper (not electronic) visa.
I have no information about my parent(s), what should I indicate in the application?
If you have no information about your parents, you should indicate "no information" in the corresponding fields.
I am traveling with my child, does he/she need a visa too? Should I fill in an application form?
If you are traveling with minor children who are registered in your passport, a separate application for an electronic visa must be submitted for each child. All minor children traveling with their parents must have an individual electronic visa.
Is it necessary to provide an e-mail address and phone number in the application form?
Yes, since notifications about the progress and results of the application processing are sent to your e-mail address. Notifications are also available in your personal account on the specialized website and in the mobile application.
A contact phone number may be necessary in case of emergency notification of an alien about any unforeseen circumstances related to his/her entry into, exit from and stay in Russia.
I filled in the application form, I received a message on the e-mail that I need to make corrections. What should I do?
If the processing of the application reveals any incorrect information in it, its further processing will be suspended and it will be returned to you for corrections, with comments and indication of the items of the application to be corrected. The application is returned for correction within a period of not more than 2 calendar days from the date of submission of the application. The status of the application can be tracked through the personal account page. Application processing starts after all errors are corrected and takes 4 calendar days.
I entered the inaccurate information in the application form and received a visa with an incorrect date of birth. Can I make corrections to my visa?
It is not possible to change the data in the e-visa issued. Unfortunately, in this case you need to submit a new application for the e-visa.
Please inform us about any errors found in the issued e-visa at evisa_info@kdmid.ru, indicating the number of the application form, passport number and the field where the error was made. The information received will allow us to improve the service of processing applications and prevent similar situations in the future.
PAYMENT
I filled out the visa application form, but the payment did not go through. How do I know if the application has been accepted or not?
Please wait for the confirmation of your payment. Payment processing time is between 20 and 45 minutes.
What cards can I use to pay the fee?
Due to the sanctions imposed by unfriendly states, you can pay the consular fee only with cards issued by banks of other countries. It is impossible to pay the consular fee using cards issued by Russian banks. Payment is made on the specialized website of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Russia or in the mobile application of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Russia using Internet acquiring technology with bank cards of international payment systems (Visa, MasterCard, etc.). No refund of payment is provided regardless of the result of the application processing.
When submitting an application, payment of invoice established in dirhams or yuan is required. Can I pay the consular fee in euros or other local currency?
Although the invoice is issued in dirhams or yuan, the consular fee can be paid using a bank card linked to an account in any local foreign currency, with automatic conversion of funds into one of the above-mentioned currencies (the conversion fee is set by your bank).
Is it possible to pay by invoice or through PayPal?
Due to the sanctions imposed by unfriendly states, payment by invoice or through PayPal payment system is currently unavailable.
An error occurs during the process of payment.
Please contact your bank for information about the details of the payment; if the bank guarantees that the transaction is not blocked, then contact the Visa Application Center through which you paid the consular fee:
1) support@sinovisa.org, help@sinovisa.org.
2) https://support.gkd-global.com.
I would like to get a refund.
Unfortunately, there is no refund available regardless of the outcome of the application processing (see item 12 "Specific features of the e-visa and conditions of its processing").
Can I withdraw my visa application after paying the fee?
Withdrawal of applications is not possible.
I paid for my visa, but I have not received a payment confirmation (receipt). How can I get it?
Contact the Visa Application Center through which you paid the consular fee:
1) support@sinovisa.org, help@sinovisa.org.
2) https://support.gkd-global.com.
PROCESSING
It has been more than 4 days since I filled out the application form and paid the consular fee, but there is still no notification of the e-visa issuance. Is it possible to check where the problem is?
Please check your Personal account page , to see if your application has been returned for editing. The status of the application: "Returned for editing" means that incorrect information was found during the application processing. You should correct this information and then resubmit the application for processing.
If your application has the status "Accepted for Processing," check the date your application was submitted or corrected.
IMPORTANT: The day an e-visa application is submitted or resubmitted after correction is not included in the application processing time.
If you have not received a notification about the issuance of an e-visa after the expiration of the processing period (date of your application submission or resubmission after correction + 5 days), please contact evisa_info@kdmid.ru, indicating in the message your application ID, your citizenship and passport number;
If the processing period has not yet expired, please wait for your e-visa; sending a request to the support service will not speed up processing of your application.
ENTRY
I have received an e-visa, when can I enter Russia?
Since 23 August 2025, the validity period of a single electronic visa has been extended up to 120 days after the date of its issuance, with the permitted period of stay of a foreign citizen in the Russian Federation not exceeding 30 days from the date of entry into the Russian Federation. We draw your attention to the fact that the date of exit from the Russian Federation with a single electronic visa cannot be later than 120 days from the date of its issuance.
The conditions for issuing single electronic visas for foreign citizens until 23 August 2025, 00:00 (Moscow time) remain the same — the validity period of a visa is 60 days from the date of its issuance, and the duration of stay shall not exceed 16 days from the date of entry into the Russian Federation.
Where can I check if my visa has been approved? I plan to buy tickets.
You can track the status of your application in your personal account page on the specialized website of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation or through the mobile application available for downloading on the said website.
I have obtained a visa, can I visit any city in Russia?
Foreign citizens arriving in the Russian Federation on the basis of an electronic visa are free to move within the entire territory of the Russian Federation, with the exception of territories, organizations and facilities where a special permit is required in accordance with federal laws.
The purpose of my visit is tourism. I don't have hotel details as I haven't made a reservation. What should I indicate in the application form?
Please indicate the name, address and telephone number of the hotel (or other accommodation facility) where you intend to stay. No booking confirmation or any other documents confirming the purpose of travel to the Russian Federation are required.
I am a citizen of the Russian Federation, but my foreign passport has expired. Can I get an e-visa and enter Russia using a passport of another country?
In accordance with the existing Russian legislation you can enter and leave the Russian Federation only with valid documents certifying the identity of a citizen of the Russian Federation outside the territory of the Russian Federation.
To obtain such documents (foreign passport; certificate of entry (return), you should apply to the nearest Russian diplomatic mission or consular office..
I have obtained an e-visa, but I have not indicated any insurance, is this data obligatory for an e-visa?
The question about insurance in the application is not that important. Lack of data about it is not a reason for refusal of entry into the Russian Federation, nor for refusal to issue an e-visa or return of the application for reprocessing.
I arrived in Russia through a checkpoint from the list of authorized checkpoints, can I leave Russia through another checkpoint not included in the list?
No, you cannot, as the unified electronic visa is valid for entry to the Russian Federation and exit from the Russian Federation only through checkpoints across the state border of the Russian Federation, the list of which is approved by the Government of the Russian Federation (see item 2 "Characteristics of the electronic visa and conditions for its issuance").
How do I obtain migration registration?
Migration registration of foreign citizens in the Russian Federation is a mandatory procedure for any foreign citizen who has entered the territory of Russia under a visa or visa-free procedure for legal stay in the territory of the Russian Federation.
To this end, it is necessary to submit a notification of arrival at the place of stay within 7 working days. This can be done in a territorial subdivision of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Russian Federation, through one of the Russian Post , offices or through a district office of the Multifunctional Center for the provision of state municipal services ("My Documents").
In case you stay in a hotel, migration registration is carried out automatically by the hotel staff (no additional actions mentioned above are required).

PREGUNTAS FRECUENTES
SOLICITUD
¿Cuáles son los requisitos para solicitar un visado electrónico que permita entrar en Rusia?
Por favor, familiarícese con las características de solicitudes de visados electrónicos.
Cuando planifique su visita a la Federación de Rusia con un visado electrónico, tenga cuidado: el plazo para examinar su solicitud (4 días naturales) no incluirá el día en que se presente la solicitud. Si después de comprobar su solicitud se le pide que corrija datos introducidos incorrectamente, el plazo para examinar su solicitud también se desplazará y se contará a partir del día en que se vuelvan a enviar los datos de su solicitud para verificación.
No puedo hacer una foto adecuada, el sistema no acepta la foto que he hecho.
Por favor, lea atentamente las recomendaciones y requisitos a la foto subida (que se encuentra en el formulario electrónico de solicitud). Si le han devuelto una solicitud de visado electrónico para cambiar la foto, póngase en contacto con el Centro de Solicitud de Visados a través del cual Vd. ha pagado la tasa consular
1) support@sinovisa.org, help@sinovisa.org.
2) https://support.gkd-global.com.
Al rellenar el formulario de solicitud, el sistema muestra un mensaje de error en la columna "número de pasaporte" (no cumple con los requisitos). ¿Qué debo hacer?
Notifíquelo a la dirección evisa_info@kdmid.ru con una foto de su pasaporte.
Viajo en tránsito por Rusia, pero no puedo seleccionar el motivo de mi viaje como "tránsito" en el formulario de solicitud. ¿Qué debo indicar en el formulario?
El visado electrónico uniforme da derecho a entrar en la Federación de Rusia y a permanecer en la Federación de Rusia con una visita o de negocios, como turista, así como para participar en eventos científicos, culturales, sociopolíticos, económicos, deportivos y establecer vínculos y contactos pertinentes. Si el motivo de su viaje a la Federación de Rusia no se corresponde con ninguno de los anteriores, deberá solicitar un visado en papel (no electrónico) en una misión diplomática u oficina consular de la Federación de Rusia.
No tengo información sobre mis padres. ¿Qué debo indicar en el formulario?
Si no tiene información sobre sus padres, debe indicar "no hay información" en los campos correspondientes.
Tengo un hijo que viaja conmigo. ¿También necesita visado? ¿Cómo puede rellenar el formulario de solicitud?
Si Vd. viaja con hijos menores inscritos en su pasaporte, se debe presentar una solicitud de visado electrónico uniforme para cada uno de ellos. Todos los hijos menores que viajen con sus padres deben tener un visado electrónico uniforme por separado.
¿Tengo que indicar la dirección de correo electrónico y el número de teléfono en el formulario de solicitud?
Sí, ya que las notificaciones sobre el progreso y los resultados de la tramitación de solicitud se envían a su dirección de correo electrónico. Las notificaciones también se publican en su cuenta personal en el sitio web especializado y en la aplicación móvil.
El número de teléfono puede ser necesario si se requiere notificar urgentemente al extranjero cualquier circunstancia imprevista relacionada con su entrada, salida y estancia en Rusia.
He rellenado el formulario, me ha llegado un mensaje a mi correo diciendo que se requiere introducir correcciones. ¿Qué debo hacer?
Si como resultado de la tramitación de su solicitud se pone de manifiesto que alguno de los datos indicados en el formulario es incorrecto, se suspenderá la tramitación posterior de la solicitud y se le devolverá con observaciones para que Vd. introduzca las correcciones, indicando los puntos de la solicitud que se debe corregir. La solicitud se devuelve para su corrección en un plazo no superior a 2 días naturales a partir de la fecha de presentación de la solicitud. Se puede monitorear los cambios del estado de su solicitud se realiza a través de la cuenta personal. El examen de la solicitud comienza una vez corregidos todos los errores y dura 4 días naturales.
He introducido datos erróneos en mi formulario de solicitud y he obtenido un visado con una fecha de nacimiento incorrecta ¿Puedo introducir correcciones en mi visado?
No es posible modificar los datos en el visado electrónico preparado. Lamentablemente, en este caso deberá presentar una nueva solicitud de visado electrónico.
Por favor, infórmenos de cualquier error encontrado en el visado electrónico a la dirección evisa_info@kdmid.ru, indicando el número del formulario de solicitud, el número de pasaporte y el campo en el que se ha cometido el error. Esta información ayudará a mejorar el servicio de tramitación de solicitudes y a prevenir situaciones similares en el futuro.
PAGO
He rellenado el formulario de solicitud, pero el pago no se ha efectuado. ¿Cómo puedo saber si la solicitud ha sido aceptada o no?
Por favor, espere la confirmación del pago. El tiempo de procesamiento del pago oscila entre 20 y 45 minutos.
¿Qué tarjetas puedo usar para pagar la tasa?
Debido a las sanciones de los estados inamistosos, sólo se puede pagar la tasa consular con tarjetas emitidas por bancos de otros países. Es imposible pagar la tasa consular con tarjetas emitidas por bancos rusos. El pago se realiza en el sitio web especializado del Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores de Rusia o en la aplicación móvil del Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores de Rusia utilizando la tecnología de adquisición por Internet con tarjetas bancarias de sistemas de pago internacionales (Visa, MasterCard, etc.). No se realizará ningún reembolso cualquiera que sea el resultado de la tramitación de solicitud.
Al presentar la solicitud, se exige pagar contra factura emitida en dírhams o yuanes. ¿Puedo pagar la tasa consular en euros o en otra moneda local?
Aunque la factura se emite en dírhams o yuanes, se puede pagar la tasa consular con una tarjeta bancaria vinculada a una cuenta en cualquier moneda extranjera local, con conversión automática de los fondos en una de las monedas mencionadas (la comisión de conversión la fija su banco).
¿Es posible pagar contra factura o a través de Paypal?
Debido a las sanciones de los estados inamistosos, actualmente no es posible pagar contra factura o a través de Paypal.
Se produce un error durante el pago.
Por favor, póngase en contacto con su banco para obtener información sobre los detalles del pago. Si el banco le garantiza la ausencia de bloqueo, entonces póngase en contacto con el Centro de Solicitud de Visados a través del Vd. ha pagado la tasa consular.
1) support@sinovisa.org, help@sinovisa.org.
2) https://support.gkd-global.com.
Quiero que me devuelvan mi dinero.
Lo sentimos, pero no se realizará ningún reembolso cualquiera que sea el resultado de la tramitación de solicitud (véase el párrafo 12 "Características del visado electrónico uniforme y requisitos para obtenerlo").
¿Puedo retirar mi solicitud de visado después de haber pagado?
La retirada de solicitudes no está prevista.
He pagado el visado, pero no he recibido la confirmación del pago (cheque). ¿Cómo puedo obtenerla?
Póngase en contacto con el Centro de Solicitud de Visados a través del cual Vd. ha pagado la tasa consular.
1) support@sinovisa.org, help@sinovisa.org.
2) https://support.gkd-global.com.
TRAMITACIÓN DE SOLICITUDES
He rellenado el formulario de solicitud y he pagado la tasa consular, han pasado más de 4 días, pero todavía no hay notificación de expedición del visado electrónico. ¿Es posible comprobar cuál es el problema?
Por favor, compruebe su cuenta personal , su solicitud puede ser devuelta para corrección. El estado de la solicitud "Devuelta para corrección" significa que durante la tramitación de la solicitud se encontró información incorrecta, que Vd. deberá corregir y, a continuación, volver a presentar la solicitud para su tramitación.
Si el estado de su solicitud es "Aceptada para la tramitación", verifique la fecha en que se presentó o corrigió su solicitud.
¡AVISO IMPORTANTE! El día en que Vd. presenta su solicitud de visado electrónico o la vuelve a presentar después de corregirla no se incluye en el plazo de tramitación.
Si no ha recibido la notificación de expedición del visado electrónico una vez transcurrido el plazo de tramitación (día de presentación o corrección de su solicitud + 5 días), póngase en contacto con nosotros por correo electrónico evisa_info@kdmid.ru, indicando en el mensaje el número de identificación de su solicitud, la nacionalidad y el número de pasaporte;
Si el plazo de tramitación no ha expirado, espere su visado electrónico, la consulta al servicio de asistencia no acelerará el plazo de tramitación de su solicitud.
ENTRADA
He obtenido un visado electrónico. ¿Cuándo puedo entrar en Rusia?
Se puede realizar un viaje de hasta 30 días en cualquier fecha dentro de los 120 días a partir de la fecha en que se notifique la expedición del visado. Es importante que la fecha de salida de Rusia no pueda ser posterior al ciento veinte día desde la fecha en que se haya expedido el visado.
¿Cómo puedo saber si mi solicitud de visado ha sido aprobada? Quiero comprar billetes.
Puede seguir el estado de su solicitud en su cuenta personal del sitio web el sitio web especializado del Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores de Rusia o a través de la aplicación móvil que se puede descargar en dicho sitio web.
He obtenido un visado. ¿Puedo visitar cualquier ciudad de Rusia?
Los ciudadanos extranjeros que llegaron a la Federación de Rusia con un visado electrónico uniforme tienen derecho a circular libremente por todo el territorio de la Federación de Rusia, con excepción de las visitas a territorios, organizaciones e instalaciones que requieren un permiso especial de entrada en virtud de las leyes federales.
El motivo de mi visita es el turismo. No tengo los datos de contacto de hotel porque no he hecho ninguna reserva. ¿Qué debo indicar en el formulario de solicitud?
Indique el nombre, la dirección y el número de teléfono del hotel (u otro tipo de alojamiento) en el que tiene previsto alojarse. No se requiere confirmación de reserva ni ningún otro documento que justifique el motivo de viaje a la Federación de Rusia.
Soy ciudadano de la Federación de Rusia, pero mi pasaporte ha expirado. ¿Puedo obtener un visado electrónico y entrar utilizando un pasaporte de otro país?
De conformidad con la legislación rusa vigente, sólo puede entrar en y salir de la Federación de Rusia con los documentos válidos que certifican la identidad de un ciudadano ruso fuera del territorio de la Federación de Rusia.
Para obtener dichos documentos (pasaporte extranjero; certificado de entrada (retorno), debe dirigirse a la misión diplomática u oficina la Federación de Rusia más cercana.
He obtenido un visado electrónico, pero no he indicado la póliza de seguros. ¿Se requiere un seguro para solicitar el visado electrónico?
La cuestión del seguro no tiene carácter esencial. La falta de información al respecto no es motivo para denegar la entrada en la Federación de Rusia, así como para denegar la expedición de un visado electrónico o devolver la solicitud para su revisión.
He entrado en Rusia a través de un punto de control incluido en la lista aprobada. ¿Puedo salir de Rusia a través de otro punto de control que no figura en esta lista?
No, no puede, ya que el visado electrónico uniforme es válido para entrar en la Federación de Rusia o salir de la Federación de Rusia solo a través de los puntos de control en la frontera estatal de la Federación de Rusia, cuya lista fue aprobada por el Gobierno de la Federación de Rusia (véase el párrafo 2 "Características del visado electrónico uniforme y requisitos para obtenerlo").
¿Cómo realizar el registro migratorio?
Cada ciudadano extranjero que llega a la Federación de Rusia con o exento de un visado para la estancia legal en el territorio de la Federación de Rusia está obligado a realizar el procedimiento del registro migratorio.
Para ello es necesario presentar una notificación de llegada al lugar de estancia en un plazo de 7 días laborables. Se puede hacerlo en un órgano territorial del Ministerio del Interior de la Federación de Rusia, a través de una oficina de Correos de Rusia , o a través de una oficina del distrito del Centro Multifuncional para la Prestación de Servicios Estatales y Municipales ("Mis Documentos").
En caso de que Vd. se aloje en un hotel, el personal del hotel automáticamente tramitará el registro migratorio (no se requiere realizar ninguna de las acciones adicionales mencionadas).
常见问题
办理签证
办理俄罗斯入境电子签证有哪些规定？
请了解 办理电子签证的特殊性。
当您计划使用电子签证前往俄罗斯联邦时，请注意：申请受理的时间为4个日历日，不包括提交申请的当天。如果您的申请经审核后要求您修改输入错误的信息，那么您的申请受理时间也将发生变化，并从您再次提交申请信息以供审核之日起计算。
我无法正常上传照片，系统不接受我上传的照片。
请仔细阅读（电子申请表中所述）上传照片的指南和要求。如果您的电子签证申请因照片问题被退回，请联系您支付签证费的签证申请中心：
1) support@sinovisa.org, help@sinovisa.org.
2) https://support.gkd-global.com.
填写申请表时，“护照号码”一栏提示错误（不符合要求），该如何做？
请将护照照片发送至邮箱evisa_info@kdmid.ru 并说明此事。
我要经俄罗斯过境，但在申请表中无法选择“过境”作为旅行目的，我该如何填写？
统一电子签证赋予持有人以私人访问或商务考察、旅游，以及参加科学、文化、社会政治、经济、体育活动并进行相关联系和交往为目的入境俄罗斯联邦并在俄罗斯联邦逗留的权利。如果您前往俄罗斯联邦的目的不属于上述任何一种，您必须向俄罗斯联邦使馆或领事机构申请纸质（非电子）签证。
我没有父母的信息，应该在申请表中如何填写？
如果您没有父母的信息，则需在对应栏中填写“无相关信息”。
我要带孩子和我一起旅行，孩子也需要签证吗？如何给孩子填写申请表？
如果您带未成年子女同行，且他们已登记在您的护照上，则您需要为每个子女单独提交统一电子签证申请表。所有与父母同行的未成年子女都必须持有单独的统一电子签证。
是否必须在申请表上填写电子邮件地址和电话号码？
是的，因为有关申请受理进度和结果的通知会发送到电子邮件地址。此外，通知也会发布到您在专门网站和移动应用程序中的个人账户中。
如果出现任何与外国人在俄罗斯入境、出境和逗留相关的不可预见的状况必须紧急通知本人的情况，联系电话也可能会用到。
填写完申请表后，又收到了需要更正信息的通知。该如何做？
如果在处理申请时发现表格中填写的信息有误，将暂停后续受理程序，并将申请表退回给您进行修改，同时注明需要修改的申请项目栏和意见。申请应在提交之日起2个日历日内退回进行修改。可通过个人账户查询申请状态的变化。所有错误均修改完毕后开始受理申请，受理时间为 4 个日历日。
我在申请表中填写了错误信息，导致所获签证上的出生日期有误。是否可以对签证进行更正？
已完成的电子签证无法更改信息。如果发生这种情况，您必须重新提交电子签证申请。
如在已完成的电子签证中发现错误，请发送邮件至 evisa_info@kdmid.ru, 注明申请表编号、护照号码和出现错误的项目栏。我们将根据所收到的信息改进申请处理服务，避免今后再出现类似情况。
付款
我已经填写完签证申请表，但付款未成功。如何确认申请是否已提交？
请耐心等待付款确认。付款处理时间为20至45分钟。
我可以用什么卡支付费用？
因受到不友好国家的制裁，目前只能使用其他国家银行发行的银行卡支付签证费。不能使用俄罗斯银行发行的银行卡支付签证费。您可以通过俄罗斯外交部专门网站或俄罗斯外交部的手机应用程序，使用国际支付系统（Visa、MasterCard等）的银行卡，通过互联网收单技术进行支付。无论申请处理结果如何均不退款。
提交申请时，系统要求用迪拉姆或人民币账户支付，我可以用欧元或其他本地货币支付签证费吗？
虽然发票是以迪拉姆或人民币开具的，但签证费可以用与任何本地外币账户关联的银行卡支付，款项会自动兑换成上述货币（兑换手续费由您的银行确定）。
是否可以通过账户或Paypal支付？
因受到不友好国家的制裁，目前无法通过账户或Paypal支付系统付款。
付款时提示错误。
请联系您的银行了解支付详情，如果银行保证银行卡没有锁定，请联系您支付签证费的签证申请中心：
1) support@sinovisa.org, help@sinovisa.org.
2) https://support.gkd-global.com.
我想退款。
很抱歉，无论申请处理结果如何均不退款（参见"统一电子签证的特殊性及其办理条件”第12条"）。
我可以在付款后撤销自己的签证申请吗？
没有撤销申请的规定。
我已经支付了签证费用，但没有收到付款确认（发票），如何获取发票？
请联系您支付签证费的签证申请中心：
1) support@sinovisa.org, help@sinovisa.org.
2) https://support.gkd-global.com.
处理申请
我已经填完申请表并支付了签证费，但已经超过4天仍未收到电子签证的签发通知。是否可以检查一下问题出在哪里？
请查看您的个人账户 , 您的申请可能被退回重新编辑。申请状态“退回重新编辑”表示在处理申请过程中发现信息有误，需修改后重新提交处理。
如果您的申请状态为 “正在处理”，请检查签证的提交日期或更正日期。
请注意！ 提交电子签证申请或更正后重新提交申请的当天不算在受理时间内。
如果您在受理截止日期（提交或更正申请当天+5天）后仍未收到电子签证的签发通知，请发送邮件至evisa_info@kdmid.ru, 并在通知中注明您的申请ID、国籍和护照号码；
如果受理期尚未结束，请耐心等待您的电子签证，联系支持部门不会加快申请的受理时间。
入境
我已获取电子签证，何时可以入境俄罗斯？
可在收到签发通知后的120天内的任何日期出行，逗留期限不超过30天。请注意，离开俄罗斯的日期不能晚于自获取签证之日起的第120天。
我可以从何处得知我的签证是否已获批准？我想购买机票。
您可以在俄罗斯外交部专门 网站的个人账户中查询您的申请状态 也可以从该网站上下载手机应用程序进行查询。
我已获取签证，可以前往俄罗斯的任何城市吗？
持统一电子签证抵达俄罗斯联邦的外国公民有权在俄罗斯联邦全境自由行动，但根据联邦法律需要获得特别许可才能访问的区域、组织和设施除外。
我出行的目的是旅游。由于我尚未预订酒店，所以我没有酒店的详细信息，应该在申请表中填写哪些内容？
请填写您计划入住的酒店（或其他住宿设施）的名称、地址和电话。无需提供确认预订或任何其他证明前往俄罗斯联邦旅行目的的文件。
我是俄罗斯联邦公民，但我的护照已经过期，我可以用其他国家的护照申请电子签证入境吗？
根据俄罗斯现行法律，您只能在俄罗斯联邦境外使用俄罗斯联邦公民的有效身份证件出入境。
如需办理此类证件 (护照; 入境（回国）证明）, 应向最近的俄罗斯使馆或领事机构提出申请
我获取了电子签证，但我没有指定保险，电子签证中是否必须要有保险？
申请表中关于保险的问题不是至关重要的问题。未提供相关信息不能作为拒绝入境俄罗斯联邦，以及拒绝签发电子签证或退回申请进行完善的理由。
我通过授权清单中的一个口岸入境俄罗斯，我是否可以通过未列入清单的另一个口岸从俄罗斯出境？
不可以，因为统一电子签证只适用于经俄罗斯联邦政府批准的俄罗斯联邦边境口岸入境和出境俄罗斯联邦（参见 "统一电子签证的特殊性及其办理条件”第二条"）。
如何办理移民登记？
外国公民在俄罗斯联邦境内办理移民居留登记是所有通过签证或免签进入俄罗斯境内合法逗留的外国公民必须办理的手续。
为此，必须在7个工作日内办理落地签。此项事宜可以在 俄罗斯联邦内务部, 下属辖区分部 通过俄罗斯邮政 , 分局或通过 国家市政多功能服务中心（“我的证件”） 地区分部进行办理。

Important Information for Travelers to Israel: ETA-IL Requirement
The Population and Immigration Authority (PIBA) announces that starting January 1, 2025, nationals of visa-exempt countries are required to have an approved ETA-IL (Electronic Travel Authorization) before their departure for Israel.
Please Note:
Obtain your ETA-IL only at the official government website (the URL ends with "gov.il").
The ETA-IL costs only 25 Israeli Shekel, which is less than 7 dollars.
You will receive an email notification when PIBA receives your request.
You can expect a response to your application within 72 hours of submitting it.
PIBA will send a receipt for your payment. If you don't receive a receipt, you haven't used the official ETA-IL website.
Do you have any questions?
Email eta@piba.gov.il 24/7!

Frequently Asked Questions
1. Who should apply for an e-Visa?
This site allows any foreigner wishing to visit the Republic of Benin to submit their e-Visa application online. However, Africans can visit Benin without a visa for 90 days.
2. What will be the start date of validity of the e-Visa that will be issued to me?
The start date of validity will be the date of entry into Benin that you indicate in your online request in the "Trip data" section.
3. How long will the e-Visa that will be issued to me be valid?
The validity period of the e-Visa will be the one you choose in your request: 30 days or 90 days.
4. How do I choose the right e-Visa?
The right visa is chosen according to the length of your stay.
5. When should I apply for e-Visa?
We recommend that you apply for eVisa online at least 7 days before your date of entry to Benin. However, it is not possible to apply more than 90 days before your date of entry into Benin.
6. Can I modify the e-Visa after it has been issued?
As the issuance of the e-Visa is an automated process, it is not possible to modify the e-Visa once it has been issued. We advise you to read the form carefully before submitting.
7. Can I get my money back?
No it is not possible to get a refund. We advise you to be sure of the information before applying.
8. What should I do when my e-Visa expires during my stay in Benin?
When your e-Visa expires during your stay in Benin, please contact the office of emigration and immigration to extend it.
9. How long does it take to process the e-Visa application?
The treatment can last from one hour to 96 hours.
10. What type of visa card do I need for payment?
The payment platform only supports cards with 3DS.2
